changeSet.author: eduar.troyano
changeSet.comment: Crea la tabla learning_outcomes: resultados de aprendizaje de cada tema (antes un jsonb en topics). Incluye secuencia propia, tabla de auditoría learning_outcomes_audit y el trigger learning_outcomes_audit_trg.

createTable.remarks: Measurable learning outcomes of a topic (replaces topics.learning_outcomes jsonb)

column.name: public_id
column.remarks: Public identifier exposed by the API instead of the sequential id

column.name: code
column.remarks: Outcome code, unique inside the topic

column.name: bloom_level
column.remarks: Bloom taxonomy level of the outcome

column.name: active
column.remarks: Logical state: false means deactivated (rows are never deleted)

column.name: updated_at
column.remarks: Last update timestamp, maintained by the set_updated_at trigger

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE learning_outcomes ADD CONSTRAINT learning_outcomes_bloom_level_ck CHECK (bloom_level IS NULL OR bloom_level IN ('remember', 'understand', 'apply', 'analyze', 'evaluate', 'create'))
CREATE TRIGGER learning_outcomes_set_updated_at_trg BEFORE UPDATE ON learning_outcomes FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()

column.name: audit_id
column.remarks: Primary key of the audit row

column.name: record_id
column.remarks: Id of the audited row in learning_outcomes

column.name: db_user
column.remarks: Database user that made the change

column.name: app_user_id
column.remarks: Application user that made the change (smartmentor.current_user_id)

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE learning_outcomes_audit ADD CONSTRAINT learning_outcomes_audit_operation_ck CHECK (operation IN ('INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE'))
CREATE TRIGGER learning_outcomes_audit_trg AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON learning_outcomes FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit_row_change()

rollback.sql: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS learning_outcomes_audit_trg ON learning_outcomes
